title: Easy Squash Fritters
description: These easy squash fritters are a great way to use up any excessive summer squash for a crispy side that pairs well with almost any main dish.
ingredients: 0.5 cup all-purpose baking mix (such as Bisquick®)
salt and ground black pepper to taste
1 pinch garlic and herb seasoning, or more to taste
0.33333334326744 cup oil for frying, or as needed

steps.text: Mix grated squash, baking mix, milk, egg, Parmesan cheese, butter, salt, pepper, and garlic-herb seasoning together in a large bowl.

Heat oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Drop tablespoonfuls of the batter into the hot oil about 1 inch apart. Cook for 1 ½ to 2 minutes; flip and continue cooking until lightly browned on the second side. Drain on a paper towel-lined plate. Repeat with remaining batter, adding oil to the skillet as needed.
